description: Source file implementing utility functions for converting between NSImage/NSImageRep and SkBitmap, as well as color conversions between NSColor, CGColorRef, and SkColor, specifically for macOS platform integration within Skia graphics library.

methods.name: NSImageOrNSImageRepToSkBitmapWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts an NSImage or NSImageRep to a SkBitmap with specified size and color space.

methods.name: SkMatrixToCGAffineTransform
methods.description: Converts a SkMatrix to a CGAffineTransform, ensuring no perspective transforms are included.

methods.name: CGRectToSkRect
methods.description: Converts a CGRect to a SkRect.

methods.name: SkIRectToCGRect
methods.description: Converts a SkIRect to a CGRect.

methods.name: SkRectToCGRect
methods.description: Converts a SkRect to a CGRect.

methods.name: NSSystemColorToSkColor
methods.description: Converts an NSColor in system color space to a SkColor.

methods.name: CGColorRefToSkColor
methods.description: Converts a CGColorRef to a SkColor.

methods.name: CGColorCreateFromSkColor
methods.description: Creates a CGColorRef from a SkColor.

methods.name: NSDeviceColorToSkColor
methods.description: Converts an NSColor to SkColor in device RGB space.

methods.name: SkColorToCalibratedNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to a calibrated NSColor.

methods.name: SkColorToDeviceNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to a device NSColor.

methods.name: SkColorToSRGBNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to an sRGB NSColor.

methods.name: CGImageToSkBitmap
methods.description: Converts a CGImageRef to a SkBitmap.

methods.name: NSImageToSkBitmapWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts an NSImage to a SkBitmap with specified color space.

methods.name: NSImageRepToSkBitmapWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts an NSImageRep to a SkBitmap with specified size and color space.

methods.name: SkBitmapToNSBitmapImageRepWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to an NSBitmapImageRep with specified color space.

methods.name: SkBitmapToNSImageWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to an NSImage with specified color space.
